subject: Source-only F-85 insight and Relay behavior
body:
FT-HERMES/1
CONTRACT: ACK-NACK-1
TYPE: TASK
TASK: CODEX-F85-INSIGHT-RELAY-R1
WIRE: CODEX-F85-INSIGHT-RELAY-R1-START-001
SEQ: 1
IN_REPLY_TO: NONE
STATE: OPEN
TERMINAL: NO
NEXT_OWNER: HERMES
NEXT_ACTION: Read the exact current source ref, materialize COPY_ROOT, then return one evidence-bearing PROGRESS after a real source/test delta and one terminal DELIVERY or BLOCKED. Do not return an ACK-only completion.
REASON: NEW_SOURCE_LANE
SOURCE_REF: c253f68fa118485b463f85f1ff416786e0d85c6e
COPY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/work/codex-f85-insight-relay-r1
LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE
DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, deployment, live database, migrations execution, provider credentials, OAuth secrets, external provider calls, permissions, systemd, network, service restarts, commit, push

MISSION
Implement only the missing source behavior in the current architecture for F-85 "What is working" insights and the F-85/F-28 Relay path. Preserve the existing tenant/model-scoped viral evidence, published-provider-only provenance, minimum sample rules, digest scheduling, and truthful unavailable states. Do not replace the existing viral or digest contracts and do not invent conversion, causality, statistical significance, external delivery, or provider success.

PASS CRITERIA
1. Start from SOURCE_REF exactly and make real source changes under COPY_ROOT; a copied baseline, docs-only claim, generated build output, or pure type contract is not a delivery.
2. Audit the current F-85/F-28 source before editing. The implementation must use existing viral_exemplar/post_metric evidence and existing relay_card/digest/job contracts, preserve org/model scoping and RLS assumptions, and avoid raw provider payloads, secrets, signed URLs, or member PII.
3. Add the smallest real source slice that closes a currently open F-85 requirement: insight output must expose only verified published evidence with its sample threshold and observational/unavailable boundaries; digest/Relay state must distinguish stored-card creation from queued/running/done/dead or external-delivery-unknown work; no UI or API response may claim that an external channel delivered a card when only a database row exists. If the existing contracts cannot safely support the requested behavior without an unapproved schema redesign, return terminal BLOCKED naming the exact contract conflict instead of inventing one.
4. Wire the behavior to a reachable existing API/dashboard or mobile surface when the current architecture names one. Loading, empty, error, retry, disabled-safety and operator-review states must remain truthful; do not add an orphan page or a control that reports success without a durable response.
5. Add focused behavior tests for positive evidence, no-evidence/unavailable behavior, tenant/model isolation, insufficient-sample handling, duplicate/idempotent scheduling or card creation, and the distinction between stored/queued/failed/unknown external delivery. Do not use live provider calls or live database state.
6. Run the owning focused tests, typechecks and builds for every changed package. Record exact commands and exit codes.
7. DELIVERY must include exact source HEAD, isolated artifact path, changed repository-relative paths, independently reproducible SHA-256 per changed file, behavior-test names/counts, and a changed-file summary. Include LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE and explicitly state that no deployment, installer, migration execution, live database, provider, credential, permission, network or service action occurred.

CORRECTION BOUNDARY
Codex will audit this lane once. If a named source criterion fails but is locally correctable, Codex will issue one exact correction receipt. If the same criterion fails again or the contract is genuinely unavailable, return terminal BLOCKED; do not loop on ACKs or unchanged PROGRESS.

Every reply must use the strict FT-HERMES/1 protocol, include READ_STATUS where required, correlate with the exact WIRE, and end exactly with:
sincerely, Codex
